provenance: synthetic teaching cases, not runtime observations
capability: fixed ConfigMap initial-value checks; separate stateful update observation

cases.task: Trace hello-config/message through environment and volume fields.
cases.expected: Both consumers reference the same namespaced key;mount path is read-only /config/message.

cases.task: Use the configured hello source under a freshly qualified contract-2 lease.
cases.expected: Fresh client verifies /version plus /message=reviewer and /file-message=reviewer,then owned cleanup.

cases.task: Keep the same process while a synthetic ConfigMap value changes from hello to reviewer.
cases.expected: Existing environment remains hello until a new process starts.

cases.task: In an authorized stateful host lab,record API value,file bytes and application response separately.
cases.expected: After observed projection,the file may be reviewer;application changes only if it rereads/reloads as designed.

cases.task: Try a Secret reference,hostPath,subPath or arbitrary environment variable in a scratch source.
cases.expected: Broker rejection before API mutation;the approved fixed reference still parses.

cases.task: Write a before/after record for a new message value with rollback and cleanup identities.
cases.expected: Record includes ConfigMap version/UID,Pod generation/UID,observed routes and restored source if rollback is needed.
